verdict.rationale: Retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for terminal emulators, since some persist session history or sync data, so the axis applies. The pack documents no data-retention policy, history persistence settings, or deletion or clearing controls. The scrollback line limit, where 0 disables scrolling, is a display and usability setting rather than a documented privacy retention or deletion capability, so it is an adjacent control and earns no credit.
